summary: Santander UK Group Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K to notify holders of a voluntary full redemption of its 1.673% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Notes due 2027. The redemption will occur on June 14, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest to but excluding the redemption date. No premium, tender offer, or change of control is involved; it is a routine debt redemption under the indenture. This is a normal capital market transaction, not a special situation event.
